wand_of_cure_minor_wounds.name: wand of cure minor wounds
wand_of_cure_minor_wounds.lore: The apprentice healer's cantrip stick. A pale birch shaft polished by years of hedge-witch hands. Closes small cuts and eases bruises.

wand_of_cure_light_wounds.name: wand of cure light wounds
wand_of_cure_light_wounds.lore: Temple healers hand these out to any pilgrim brave enough to walk the mountain roads. Twice the mending of the apprentice's cantrip.

wand_of_healing.name: wand of healing
wand_of_healing.lore: Carved from healing oak that grows only near druidic shrines. The tree's slow, steady vigor passes into flesh at the wand's touch.

wand_of_greater_healing.name: wand of greater healing
wand_of_greater_healing.lore: Physician-mages of the late Empire could patch a knight run-through by a lance and send him back to the line. This wand is that art on a stick.

wand_of_full_restoration.name: wand of full restoration
wand_of_full_restoration.lore: A relic-grade healing wand of ivory and gold leaf. What it heals stays healed; what it mends returns stronger than before.

wand_of_fire_spark.name: wand of fire sparks
wand_of_fire_spark.lore: An apprentice pyromancer's first wand. Throws a shower of hot orange sparks that scorches the target and, sometimes, the caster's sleeve.

wand_of_fire_bolt.name: wand of fire bolt
wand_of_fire_bolt.lore: A journeyman's wand. Fires a compact bolt of flame that punches through leather and cloth alike.

wand_of_fireball.name: wand of fireball
wand_of_fireball.lore: The classic mage-wand shape. Hurls a rolling ball of fire that bursts on impact with a satisfying whump.

wand_of_fire_storm.name: wand of fire storm
wand_of_fire_storm.lore: A senior pyromancer's tool. What it fires is not a bolt but a roaring column of flame that leaves the wall behind the target scorched black.

wand_of_cataclysm.name: wand of cataclysm
wand_of_cataclysm.lore: Archmage-grade. The wand's tip glows red-hot before firing, and the target is engulfed in a column of white flame hotter than any forge.

wand_of_static_spark.name: wand of static spark
wand_of_static_spark.lore: An apprentice's stormweaver stick. Fires a crackling arc of static that makes hair stand up and small creatures yelp.

wand_of_lightning_bolt.name: wand of lightning bolt
wand_of_lightning_bolt.lore: The workhorse of storm-mages. A copper core channels a straight bolt of lightning that arcs in a clean line to the target.

wand_of_chain_lightning.name: wand of chain lightning
wand_of_chain_lightning.lore: The bolt does not stop at one target. It jumps from body to body along the line of sight, ignoring armor and finding metal wherever it hides.

wand_of_thunderstorm.name: wand of thunderstorm
wand_of_thunderstorm.lore: Master stormweavers cut these from oak struck by real lightning. When fired, the corridor briefly smells of ozone and the walls hum.

wand_of_zeus_wrath.name: wand of Zeus's wrath
wand_of_zeus_wrath.lore: Named for the Olympian thunderer whose weapon it echoes. The bolt is white, silent for an eye-blink, then arrives with a crack that rattles teeth.

wand_of_chill.name: wand of chill
wand_of_chill.lore: An apprentice cryomancer's wand. Breathes a puff of frost that numbs fingers and slows the target for a step or two.

wand_of_cold_bolt.name: wand of cold bolt
wand_of_cold_bolt.lore: Journeyman-grade ice-craft. Fires a shard of true cold that crusts the target's skin with frost and steals its speed.

wand_of_frost.name: wand of frost
wand_of_frost.lore: A master cryomancer's tool. The shaft is cold to the touch even in summer; the bolt it fires drops the target's body temperature to dangerous lows.

wand_of_blizzard.name: wand of blizzard
wand_of_blizzard.lore: Fires a howling wall of driven snow and ice needles. Even survivors leave the encounter with skin the color of bruised plums.

wand_of_absolute_zero.name: wand of absolute zero
wand_of_absolute_zero.lore: Archmage-grade cryomancy. The wand approaches the theoretical limit: motion itself is drained from the target's atoms for one merciless instant.

wand_of_acid_sting.name: wand of acid sting
wand_of_acid_sting.lore: Alchemist's cantrip. Squirts a stinging drop of caustic fluid that raises welts and eats through cheap armor stitching.

wand_of_acid_spray.name: wand of acid spray
wand_of_acid_spray.lore: Fires a spreading cone of green acid. The target smokes for a few turns and its scales or plate turn to soft flakes.

wand_of_acid_blast.name: wand of acid blast
wand_of_acid_blast.lore: A blast of concentrated caustic that leaves the stone floor pitted where droplets fall. Best not to check what happens to bone.

wand_of_corrosion.name: wand of corrosion
wand_of_corrosion.lore: The corrosion is not merely chemical; the acid finds and eats every weak point in armor, weapon, and flesh at once.

wand_of_dissolution.name: wand of dissolution
wand_of_dissolution.lore: Archmage-grade alchemy. What the wand hits does not merely burn; it comes apart at the bonds that hold matter together.

wand_of_force_dart.name: wand of force dart
wand_of_force_dart.lore: An apprentice's first offensive spell on a stick. Fires a small dart of pure force that ignores armor entirely.

wand_of_magic_missile.name: wand of magic missile
wand_of_magic_missile.lore: The classic. A missile of pure kinetic force that unerringly finds its target through cover, smoke, and armor alike.

wand_of_force_barrage.name: wand of force barrage
wand_of_force_barrage.lore: A barrage of magic missiles fired in rapid succession. Each one is irresistible; together they punch through even magical protection.

wand_of_force_storm.name: wand of force storm
wand_of_force_storm.lore: Master abjurers use these to bring down single high-value targets. The storm of missiles cannot be dodged, blocked, or resisted.

wand_of_force_cataclysm.name: wand of force cataclysm
wand_of_force_cataclysm.lore: Archmage-grade force magic. What arrives at the target is not missiles anymore, but the concept of impact rendered undeniable.

wand_of_rap.name: wand of rap
wand_of_rap.lore: A schoolmaster's discipline wand, enchanted to strike harder than its weight suggests. Best used on things that cannot rap back.

wand_of_striking.name: wand of striking
wand_of_striking.lore: A journeyman evoker's punch on a stick. The tip flashes and the target is struck as though by an invisible war hammer.

wand_of_slam.name: wand of slam
wand_of_slam.lore: The wand fires a battering-ram of force that has been known to crack shields and dent breastplates on the same blow.

wand_of_smite.name: wand of smite
wand_of_smite.lore: The tip strikes the target as though guided by a righteous hand. Armor buckles inward; bone follows.

wand_of_devastation.name: wand of devastation
wand_of_devastation.lore: Archmage-grade evocation. Whatever the wand strikes, the strike is remembered by the stone behind it in the shape of a crater.

wand_of_drowsing.name: wand of drowsing
wand_of_drowsing.lore: A hedge-witch's calming wand. The target's eyelids grow heavy for a short spell -- long enough to run past, or line up a killing blow.

wand_of_sleep.name: wand of sleep
wand_of_sleep.lore: The classic sleep wand. The target folds where it stands and does not stir until slapped awake or hit hard enough to matter.

wand_of_deep_slumber.name: wand of deep slumber
wand_of_deep_slumber.lore: Archmage-grade enchantment. The sleep is not restful; it is closer to a coma, and even great beasts do not shake it off before you leave the room.

wand_of_slow.name: wand of slow
wand_of_slow.lore: An apprentice wand. Weighs the target down for a few turns, enough to disengage or set up a clean shot.

wand_of_torpor.name: wand of torpor
wand_of_torpor.lore: A senior enchanter's slowing wand. The target's blood flows sluggishly; its swings arrive a full beat late.

wand_of_time_halt.name: wand of time halt
wand_of_time_halt.lore: Archmage-grade chronomancy. Time thickens around the target like cold honey; it moves, but barely, and you can afford to be patient.

wand_of_bewilderment.name: wand of bewilderment
wand_of_bewilderment.lore: A prankster's wand. The target briefly forgets which way is up and which way you are; useful for slipping out of a bad room.

wand_of_confusion.name: wand of confusion
wand_of_confusion.lore: Standard confusion craft. The target reels, swings at empty air, and sometimes turns on its own allies.

wand_of_madness.name: wand of madness
wand_of_madness.lore: Archmage-grade enchantment. The target's mind unravels; it does not merely stumble but forgets what it was doing and, briefly, what it is.

wand_of_hold.name: wand of hold
wand_of_hold.lore: An apprentice binder's wand. Fixes the target in place for a heartbeat -- long enough for a decisive move or an honest retreat.

wand_of_paralysis.name: wand of paralysis
wand_of_paralysis.lore: Journeyman binding-craft. The target locks up entirely; if you have a killing blow in hand, this is the wand that lets you land it.

wand_of_petrifaction.name: wand of petrifaction
wand_of_petrifaction.lore: Archmage-grade binding. The target's flesh briefly takes on the density of granite; it cannot move, cannot flinch, cannot bleed until the spell breaks.

wand_of_terror.name: wand of terror
wand_of_terror.lore: A hedge-witch's fright-stick. The target's courage briefly leaves it and it looks for the nearest exit.

wand_of_fear.name: wand of fear
wand_of_fear.lore: Standard fear-magic. Even a hardened veteran of the deep floors will drop what it is doing and run when this wand fires.

wand_of_panic_wave.name: wand of panic wave
wand_of_panic_wave.lore: Archmage-grade terror-craft. The wave of unreasoning dread reaches every creature the caster can see; the room empties in seconds.

wand_of_dimming.name: wand of dimming
wand_of_dimming.lore: A hedge-mage's dazzle wand. The target's sight fogs for a moment -- long enough to slip out of its line of attack.

wand_of_blindness.name: wand of blindness
wand_of_blindness.lore: Standard blinding-craft. The target claws at its eyes; even ranged attackers cannot line up a shot on a foe they cannot see.

wand_of_dark_curse.name: wand of dark curse
wand_of_dark_curse.lore: Archmage-grade curse-craft. The darkness the wand lays on the target's eyes is not merely blindness; it is the absence of the world entirely.

wand_of_rebuke.name: wand of rebuke
wand_of_rebuke.lore: A novice priest's rebuke-wand. Holy light shines on the undead in sight; they take searing damage and flee from it.

wand_of_turn_undead.name: wand of turn undead
wand_of_turn_undead.lore: A senior cleric's wand of the standard turning rite. Undead in sight are burned by holy fire and driven back in terror.

wand_of_sunburst.name: wand of sunburst
wand_of_sunburst.lore: Archmage-and-cardinal grade. The wand fires a burst of daylight so pure that lesser undead are unmade where they stand; the greater ones scream and run.

wand_of_small_polymorph.name: wand of small polymorph
wand_of_small_polymorph.lore: A journeyman transmuter's wand. Turns the target into something small and unthreatening -- a rat, a frog, an anxious bat.

wand_of_polymorph.name: wand of polymorph
wand_of_polymorph.lore: The standard transmuter's wand. The target becomes another creature -- sometimes better, sometimes worse, always different.

wand_of_curse_of_the_menagerie.name: wand of curse of the menagerie
wand_of_curse_of_the_menagerie.lore: Archmage-grade transmutation. What the wand hits becomes some small, weak, twitching thing for a long while, and remembers being it.

wand_of_charm.name: wand of charm
wand_of_charm.lore: The classic charm wand. The target regards you as a dear friend for as long as the spell holds -- long enough to walk past, or to have it do you a favor.

wand_of_greater_charm.name: wand of greater charm
wand_of_greater_charm.lore: A master enchanter's wand. Even hardened veterans and larger monsters warm to the wielder for the duration.

wand_of_dominion.name: wand of dominion
wand_of_dominion.lore: Archmage-grade enchantment. The target does not merely like you; it defers to you as a subject to a rightful king.

wand_of_candle_light.name: wand of candle light
wand_of_candle_light.lore: An apprentice's illumination wand. Casts a small warm glow that pushes back the near darkness -- enough to see the next few tiles clearly.

wand_of_torch_light.name: wand of torch light
wand_of_torch_light.lore: A journeyman explorer's wand. The tip flares like a well-tarred torch and lights the whole surrounding chamber.

wand_of_sunlight.name: wand of sunlight
wand_of_sunlight.lore: Master illuminator's wand. Floods the entire floor with daylight and reveals hidden and invisible creatures alike -- for one merciless instant.

wand_of_wonder.name: wand of wonder
wand_of_wonder.lore: Nobody knows what this wand will do next. It might heal you, blast your foes, or do something entirely unexpected. The chaos is the point.

wand_of_greater_wonder.name: wand of greater wonder
wand_of_greater_wonder.lore: A master's wonder-wand. The outcomes are drawn from a much wider pool; the good ones are much better and the bad ones are much worse.

wand_of_chaos.name: wand of chaos
wand_of_chaos.lore: Archmage-grade chaos-craft. What happens when this wand fires is not on any table anywhere; the wielder is as surprised as the target.

wand_of_digging.name: wand of digging
wand_of_digging.lore: A dungeoneer's essential. Blasts open walls, doors, and secret passages in a straight line -- convenient for shortcuts and for escape.

wand_of_cancellation.name: wand of cancellation
wand_of_cancellation.lore: A master abjurer's wand. Strips the target of every magical buff and enchantment it was wearing, leaving it as it was born.

wand_of_drain_magic.name: wand of drain magic
wand_of_drain_magic.lore: Strips magical effects from the target and, in the doing, drains the caster's own spent charge back into the wand for the next zap.

wand_of_dispel_magic.name: wand of dispel magic
wand_of_dispel_magic.lore: The standard dispelling wand. Removes one positive magical effect from the target -- the shield, the haste, the invisibility, whatever mattered most.

wand_of_teleport_monster.name: wand of teleport monster
wand_of_teleport_monster.lore: A conjurer's escape-hatch wand. Sends the target to a random tile on the floor -- ideally very far from you.

wand_of_poison_monster.name: wand of poison monster
wand_of_poison_monster.lore: An alchemist's wand. The target is poisoned for a long spell -- the damage is not immediate, but it is very reliable.

wand_of_disease_monster.name: wand of disease monster
wand_of_disease_monster.lore: A necromancer's disease-wand. The target is wracked with sickness that lingers long after the fight, and takes a heavy toll immediately.

wand_of_curse_monster.name: wand of curse monster
wand_of_curse_monster.lore: A master hexer's wand. Lays a slow-burning curse on the target that saps its speed and its luck at once.

wand_of_weaken_monster.name: wand of weaken monster
wand_of_weaken_monster.lore: A journeyman debuffer's wand. Saps the target's strength and endurance for a stretch, softening the fight to come.

wand_of_secret_door_detection.name: wand of secret door detection
wand_of_secret_door_detection.lore: A dungeoneer's dowsing wand. Reveals any secret doors within the caster's sight radius -- the passages become clearly visible in the wall.

wand_of_opening.name: wand of opening
wand_of_opening.lore: A thief-mage's wand. Every closed door within sight swings open; every locked chest clicks and lifts its lid.

wand_of_probing.name: wand of probing
wand_of_probing.lore: A scholar's diagnostic wand. Reveals the target's true HP, its saves, and any resistances or vulnerabilities it carries.

wand_of_death_ray.name: wand of death ray
wand_of_death_ray.lore: Archmage-grade necromancy. A single black beam. If the target's save fails, its heart stops; if it saves, its heart wishes it had not.

wand_of_disintegrate.name: wand of disintegrate
wand_of_disintegrate.lore: Archmage-grade evocation. What the beam touches ceases to be; wall or flesh, the wand does not distinguish, and neither does the aftermath.

wand_of_life_drain.name: wand of life drain
wand_of_life_drain.lore: A journeyman necromancer's wand. Steals a portion of the target's life force and returns it to the caster as healing.

wand_of_soul_drain.name: wand of soul drain
wand_of_soul_drain.lore: A master necromancer's wand. Draws a full share of the target's life across the room and pours it into the caster's veins.

caduceus_wand.name: Caduceus of Hermes
caduceus_wand.unidentified_name: a golden rod entwined with two serpents
caduceus_wand.lore: The caduceus -- two serpents wound around a winged staff -- was carried by Hermes, messenger of the gods. Often confused with the Rod of Asclepius (the true medical symbol, with one snake), the caduceus nonetheless became the emblem of healing across the Western world. Each charge restores the body as if guided by divine medicine.

lantern_of_diogenes.name: Lantern of Diogenes
lantern_of_diogenes.lore: Diogenes of Sinope carried a lantern through the streets of Athens in broad daylight. When asked why, he said: 'I am looking for an honest man.' He lived in a barrel, owned nothing, and told Alexander the Great to move because he was blocking the sun. This lantern still burns with that relentless search for truth -- its light reveals hidden things and never seems to run out.

iron_mortar_wand.name: Baba Yaga's Iron Mortar
iron_mortar_wand.lore: Baba Yaga grinds the bones of heroes in this mortar before eating them. When wielded as a wand, it channels chaotic magic -- the effect is never the same twice.

aarons_rod.name: Aaron's Rod
aarons_rod.lore: The rod of Aaron, brother of Moses. Thrown to the ground before Pharaoh's court, it became a serpent and swallowed the serpents of Pharaoh's magicians. Later, it budded almonds overnight to settle a dispute among the tribes. From Exodus 7 and Numbers 17. Whatever an enemy raises, the rod takes the legs out from under it.

circes_wand.name: Circe's Wand
circes_wand.lore: Circe's wand from her hall on Aeaea. She used it on Odysseus's crew and they became swine -- heads and bristles and grunts, but their minds knew themselves the whole time. Hermes gave Odysseus the herb moly to resist her; she gave up after the swine-spell failed and welcomed him. From the Odyssey, Book X.

indras_vajra.name: Indra's Vajra
indras_vajra.lore: The thunderbolt of Indra, made by Tvastr the divine craftsman from the bones of the sage Dadhichi, who gave his body for it. Indra struck Vritra the world-drought serpent with this and freed the seven rivers. From the Rigveda, Book I. It is not lightning -- it is the weapon that lightning was a memory of.
